configuration.stages: proposal plus decoder0..5; reconstruct proposal via native gather/decoder_query_proj, replay six cached-feature decoders and require every query tensor bitexact; no cross-slot reorder
configuration.early_consensus: equal mean of softmax(candidate native T logodds) across proposal+decoder0..4; no final stage in teacher
configuration.role_readout: native entity logodds minus log(number positive tokens) for span-length scale; target minus logmeanexp of available reference scores; final and equal-mean early role distributions fixed, no per-case best layer
configuration.short_phrase: new same3EED subject literal phrase forward with all phrasecontent positive/excluding sentinel; existing R51 reference-headspan semantic caches, unknown generic heads not a negative
configuration.cross_text_association: same unique raw input point IDs; affinity=sqrt(supportJaccard*axisalignedboxIoU), >=4sharedpoints; column mass W=A/(1+sum_i A), unassigned retained; no slot-number equality
configuration.phrase_readout: target mapped semantic mass plus unassigned*source distribution; references mapped mass plus unassigned uniform; normalize target/reference-relative semantic support, no fixed reference Top1
configuration.main_consensus: equal mean of early raw consensus, early role consensus and mapped phrase-role distribution; fixed initial source projections, stopgradient
configuration.TTA: existing full query matching MLP184960params only, frozen backbone/texthead/boxes; minimize KL(fixed initial semantic consensus||current final target candidate distribution), Adam5e-4 1/3steps no extra rule/entropy/keep loss, reset each sample/signal
configuration.control: single input-hash fixed candidate permutation of complete initial consensus; same candidate-mass/entropy, original source indexing unchanged
configuration.readouts: 19arms; source/zero, six earlier stage diagnostics, fixed early and role and phrase reads, main consensus/shuffle and TTA1/3 real/shuffle
configuration.decision: same-information direct and zero controls determine task gain; loss/parameters/early oracle do not establish success. Stop fixed checkpoint rule-loss exploration if no overall signal; source preparation is recommendation only.
